data.name: Tziporah
data.long_meaning: God will bird. In Hebrew Bible, Tziporah is a girl name derived from Hebrew word Tzipor (bird), and has the biblical and spiritual significance of being a symbol of God's protection and guidance. In the Book of Exodus, Tziporah is the name of Moses' wife and sister of Jethro. She saved Moses from being stoned by her father Jethro and his shepherds, and later interceded for Moses when the angel of God threatened to kill him for not circumcising their son. Tziporah's courage and faithfulness demonstrate the power of God's protection and His ability to work through individuals.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's protection and guidance.

in_hebrew.name: ציפורה
in_hebrew.meaning: עוזרת, משרתת, או שפחה של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ציפורה הוא נגזר מהמילה העברית 'צפר', שפירושה 'עוזרת' או 'משרתת'. הוא מופיע בתנ"ך כהשם של אשתו של משה, ציפורה בת יתרו. היא הייתה בתו של יתרו, כוהן מדין, והפכה לחלק חשוב ממשפחתו של משה. השם מבטא את התפקיד החשוב של האישה הזו כעוזרת ומשרתת של אלוהים במשפחתו של משה.

in_greek.name: Τζιπορά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζιπορά προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'צפר' (tziporah), που σημαίνει 'βοηθός' ή 'διακονία'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αν και δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, η Τζιπορά είναι γνωστή ως η σύζυγος του Μωυσή, κόρη του Ιοθορ, και είχε σημαντικό ρόλο στην οικογένειά του. Το όνομα αντανακλά τη σημασία της ως βοηθού και διακονίας του Θεού στην οικογένεια του Μωυσή.

in_latin.name: Tziporah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Tziporah derivatur ex verbo hebraeo 'צפר' (tziporah), quod significat 'ministra' vel 'ancilla'. In Scriptura, Tziporah filia Iethro, sacerdotis Madian, uxor Moysis, munus importante in familia Moysis habuit. Nomen eius indicat eius officium ut ministra et ancilla Dei in familia Moysis.

in_english.name: Tziporah
in_english.meaning: Helper, assistant, or servant of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tziporah originates from the Hebrew word 'צפר' (tziporah), meaning 'helper', 'assistant', or 'servant'. Tziporah, the wife of Moses and daughter of Jethro, played a significant role in Moses' family. The name reflects her importance as a helper and servant of God within Moses' family. It symbolizes support, service, and devotion, qualities valued in Christian tradition. The name has been adopted across various Christian cultures, signifying a connection to biblical heritage and spiritual service.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tziporah holds cultural significance in Jewish communities as it is derived from the Hebrew word Tzipor, which means bird. This name has been used for generations and continues to be popular among Jewish families today.
data.spiritual_significance: Tziporah holds deep spiritual significance as a symbol of God's protection and guidance. In the Book of Exodus, Tziporah's bravery and intercession demonstrate God's power to work through individuals to save and protect His people. Her story serves as a reminder of the importance of faith and courage in the face of adversity.

historical_references.reference: According to the Old Testament, Tziporah was the midwife who saved the lives of Moses' sons during the time of the Israelites' enslavement in Egypt. The name Tziporah means 'bird' in Hebrew, and it is believed that this name was given to her due to her ability to 'bring forth' new life.
historical_references.context: The Exodus story in the Hebrew Bible

historical_references.reference: Tziporah was also the name of a 15th-century Jewish mystic who was a disciple of Isaac Luria. She is known for her role in interpreting and spreading Lurianic Kabbalah, a form of Jewish mysticism that emphasizes the importance of the soul's spiritual journey and the role of divine sparks in the physical world.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Tziporah, derived from the Hebrew word for bird, has seen a modern resurgence in popularity, particularly among individuals with Jewish heritage and those interested in Biblical names. It is also considered a beautiful and unique feminine name. The name Tziporah can be seen on various platforms, including TikTok for creative expression and exploration of Jewish heritage, Instagram for personal branding and identity, and Pinterest for home decor and fashion inspiration.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Tziporah, meaning "bird" in Hebrew, symbolizes the free spiritual soul soaring in the heavens, unfettered by earthly bonds. It also represents the Christian's call to fly above worldly distractions, inspired by God's love and guidance.
